translations.web: As clouds and wind without rain, so is he who boasts of gifts deceptively.
translations.bsb: Like clouds and wind without rain is the man who boasts of gifts never given.
translations.kjv: Whoso boasteth himself of a false gift is like clouds and wind without rain.
translations.asv: As clouds and wind without rain, So is he that boasteth himself of his gifts falsely.
